class.name: OpenXRMetaEnvironmentRaycastExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_META_environment_raycast[/code] extension, which casts rays against the live depth data of the physical environment on supported Meta Quest devices. The raycaster handle is created automatically when the OpenXR session starts and destroyed when it ends. Wait for [signal raycaster_ready] (or check [method is_raycaster_ready]) before calling [method raycast].

method.name: create_raycaster
method.description: Requests creation of the environment raycaster handle if it is not already created or being created. Creation is asynchronous; [signal raycaster_ready] is emitted once the handle is available. Returns [code]false[/code] if environment raycasting is not supported or the request could not be started.

method.name: destroy_raycaster
method.description: Destroys the environment raycaster handle (or cancels its pending creation) and releases the underlying resources.

method.name: is_environment_raycast_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if environment raycasting is supported on the current device and runtime; otherwise [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_raycaster_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the environment raycaster handle has been created and [method raycast] can be used.

method.name: raycast
method.description: Performs a raycast against the physical environment from [param origin] in direction [param direction]. [param origin], [param direction] and the returned transform are expressed in the OpenXR play space. Play space coordinates are relative to the [XROrigin3D] node, so they only match world coordinates while [XROrigin3D] is at the world origin and the view has not been recentered. Otherwise, convert with [code]xr_origin.global_transform * XRServer.get_reference_frame()[/code] (world from play space) and its inverse. A [param max_distance] of [code]0.0[/code] or less disables the distance filter, so the runtime's maximum range is used. If the raycaster is not ready or the call fails (an error is printed in that case), the returned dictionary reports [constant HIT_STATUS_NO_HIT]. Returns a [Dictionary] containing: - [code]"status"[/code] ([int]): The hit status ([enum HitStatus]). Only [constant HIT_STATUS_HIT] comes with a usable pose. - [code]"transform"[/code] ([Transform3D]): The pose of the hit point, with its Z axis pointing along the surface normal. Only valid when [code]"status"[/code] is [constant HIT_STATUS_HIT].

signal.name: raycaster_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the environment raycaster handle has been created and [method raycast] can be used.

signal.name: raycaster_error
signal.description: Emitted when creating the environment raycaster fails. [param error_code] is the [code]XrResult[/code] reported by the runtime.
